title: Testing Backward-Flatness of Nonlinear Discrete-Time Systems
summary: Despite ongoing research, testing the flatness of discrete-time systems remains a challenging problem. To date, only the property of forward-flatness - a special case of difference-flatness - can be checked in a computationally efficient manner. In this paper, we propose a systematic approach for testing backward-flatness, which is another special case of difference-flatness, and for deriving a corresponding backward-flat output.
